```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(psych)
library(scales)
library(jtools)

data <- read_csv("/Users/luiza/Projects/ERIM/Study_2/bcpe_study2.csv")

table(data$gender)
table(data$pol_id)
table(data$race)

```

## Statistical Models

```{r}

# We found that students who had more positive BCPE were more likely to have ideologically diverse friend networks
model1 <- lm(scale(coleman) ~ scale(bcpe), data = data)
summary(model1)
exp(cbind(coef(model1), confint(model1)))

# In fact, BCPE is still a negative predictor of ideological homophily even after when adjusting for empathic concern, perspective-taking, political ideology, ideological strength, race and gender

model1 <- lm(scale(coleman) ~ scale(bcpe) + scale(pol_strength) + scale(pol_id) + gender + scale(IRI_PT) + scale(IRI_EC), data = data)
summary(model1)

exp(cbind(coef(model1), confint(model1)))

# There was also no significant interaction between participants' BCPE and political ideology when predicting ideological homophily

model1 <- lm(scale(coleman) ~ scale(bcpe)*pol_id, data = data)
model2 <- lm(scale(coleman) ~ scale(bcpe) + pol_id, data = data)
anova(model2, model1)

## Panel B

model1 <- lm(scale(coleman) ~ scale(bcpe) + scale(IRI_PT) + scale(IRI_EC), data = data)
summary(model1)

plot_summs(model1, inner_ci_level = .9, 
           colors = "seagreen", coefs = c(
             "Positive BCPE" = "scale(bcpe)",
             "Dispositional PT" = "scale(IRI_PT)", 
             "Dispositional EC" = "scale(IRI_EC)"
           )
) + 
  theme_Publication() + 
  labs(x = "\n Beta Estimate \n ", y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 16))
```
